project_title: SOURCE - Gururaj Ananda Yogi AI Spiritual Companion Crowdfunding
archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY / SWISS MINIMALISM (Light Theme, Sober to Eyes)
target_audience: Older adults and spiritual seekers. Needs generous typography, high legibility, calm color palette, high contrast buttons, gentle motion.

typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif (or Work Sans / Manrope)

font_sizes.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-tight
font_sizes.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif tracking-normal leading-snug
font_sizes.label_overline: text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold tracking-widest uppercase text-amber-800

layout_and_spacing.grid_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 md:gap-8

key_functionalities: App feature list (SOURCE app: Satsang AI, Conversation Library, Mini-satsangs, Meditation Suite with Chanting/Gong/Candle/Timer/Yoga Nidra/OM, Find Teacher)
Fundraising purpose section (3 goals: 3D Visual Likeness, Complete Knowledge Base, Multi-lingual)
Donate tier cards (4 tiers: Supporter $50-500, Sponsor $750-4500, Benefactor $5000+, Investor $10000+ Contact)
Download App page (App Store / Play Store buttons + feedback form)
Floating Donate button on all pages
Footer with general info about Gururaj + Facebook AI Gururaj support page links

components: Kinetic Hero with headline reveal & background lotus visual
Editorial Marquee Banner (Satsang Wisdom • AI Spiritual Companion • Meditation)
App Store & Google Play Store Badge Buttons
App Preview Mockup Visuals & Interactive Feature Checklist
Interactive Tier Selector & Tier Cards (Supporter, Sponsor, Benefactor, Investor)
Stripe Mock Checkout Modal / Contribution Form

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all text remains crisp, highly legible (minimum 16px font size, default 18px body text for older adult accessibility).
Use warm, soothing light theme background #FAF8F5 with subtle stone borders #E5DFD5.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or harsh pure white backgrounds for main body; use off-white #FFFFFF cards over #FAF8F5 body.
Incorporate floating donate button at bottom right (fixed z-50 with shadow-lg) on ALL pages with data-testid='floating-donate-button'.
Include data-testid attributes on every button, route link, card, form element, and modal.
Implement framer-motion smooth entrance animations and marquee scroll effect for editorial ribbon.
Add Sonner toast notifications for simulated donation submission and feedback form submission.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_id_convention: All interactive elements must include data-testid in kebab-case e.g. data-testid='nav-link-donate', data-testid='donate-tier-card-supporter'
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility: High contrast, WCAG AA compliant contrast ratio for all text on light backgrounds
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Never use pure transparent backgrounds on sticky header or dropdowns; always use semi-opaque white with backdrop-blur e.g. bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-md
